1: // Meteor Dodge game implementation
2: // Targets canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11: 
12:   // Set canvas size (fallback if not set via HTML/CSS)
13:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
14:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
15: 
16:   // Game settings
17:   const shipWidth = 60;
18:   const shipHeight = 20;
19:   const shipSpeed = 6;
20:   const meteorRadius = 20;
21:   const meteorMinSpeed = 2;
22:   const meteorMaxSpeed = 5;
23:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
24: 
25:   let shipX = (canvas.width - shipWidth) / 2;
26:   const shipY = canvas.height - shipHeight - 10;
27: 
28:   let leftPressed = false;
29:   let rightPressed = false;
30: 
31:   const meteors = [];
32:   let lastSpawn = 0;
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let gameOver = false;
35:   let startTime = performance.now();
36: 
37:   // Input handling
38:   const keyDownHandler = e => {
39:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'Left') leftPressed = true;
40:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'Right') rightPressed = true;
41:   };
42:   const keyUpHandler = e => {
43:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'Left') leftPressed = false;
44:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'Right') rightPressed = false;
45:   };
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDownHandler);
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUpHandler);
48: 
49:   // Mouse/touch support (optional)
50:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
51:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
52:     const mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
53:     shipX = Math.min(canvas.width - shipWidth, Math.max(0, mouseX - shipWidth / 2));
54:   });
55: 
56:   function spawnMeteor() {
57:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - meteorRadius * 2) + meteorRadius;
58:     const speed = Math.random() * (meteorMaxSpeed - meteorMinSpeed) + meteorMinSpeed;
59:     meteors.push({ x, y: -meteorRadius, radius: meteorRadius, speed });
60:   }
61: 
62:   function update(delta) {
63:     if (gameOver) return;
64:     // Move ship
65:     if (leftPressed) shipX = Math.max(0, shipX - shipSpeed);
66:     if (rightPressed) shipX = Math.min(canvas.width - shipWidth, shipX + shipSpeed);
67: 
68:     // Spawn meteors
69:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
70:       spawnMeteor();
71:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
72:     }
73: 
74:     // Update meteors
75:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const m = meteors[i];
77:       m.y += m.speed;
78:       // Remove off-screen meteors
79:       if (m.y - m.radius > canvas.height) {
80:         meteors.splice(i, 1);
81:         continue;
82:       }
83:       // Collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
84:       const shipRect = { x: shipX, y: shipY, w: shipWidth, h: shipHeight };
85:       const distX = Math.abs(m.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
86:       const distY = Math.abs(m.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
87:       if (distX > (shipRect.w / 2 + m.radius) || distY > (shipRect.h / 2 + m.radius)) {
88:         continue; // no collision
89:       }
90:       // Collision detected
91:       gameOver = true;
92:     }
93: 
94:     // Update score based on elapsed time
95:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
96:   }
97: 
98:   function draw() {
99:     // Clear
100:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
101: 
102:     // Draw ship
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00aaff';
104:     ctx.fillRect(shipX, shipY, shipWidth, shipHeight);
105: 
106:     // Draw meteors
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aa0000';
108:     meteors.forEach(m => {
109:       ctx.beginPath();
110:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:       ctx.fill();
112:     });
113: 
114:     // Draw score
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
116:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
117:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
118: 
119:     // Game over overlay
120:     if (gameOver) {
121:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
122:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
123:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
124:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
125:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
126:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
127:     }
128:   }
129: 
130:   let lastTime = performance.now();
131:   function loop() {
132:     const now = performance.now();
133:     const delta = now - lastTime;
134:     lastTime = now;
135:     update(delta);
136:     draw();
137:     if (!gameOver) {
138:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139:     }
140:   }
141:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142: })();
